extraction.Name: Douglas Walker
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 7, 1920, by George Sully
extraction.Buyer: Walker conveyed the land to George Sully for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739612 issued; Southeast quarter and Southwest quarter of Section 4, northeast quarter of Northwest quarter, west half of Northeast quarter, section 9, township 37, north of range 27; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; deed dated April 7, 1920
